correctness.rationale: Directly derived D=d(P)+1 and L=2ell-1_{P leaf}, hence Cov=(ell U-iQ)/t^2. The internal vertices are ancestor-closed, so U<=i(i-1)/2, equality only on an internal path. Each of the i-1 internal edges has a descendant leaf, hence Q>=ell+i-1; simultaneous equality forces one terminal leaf and all remaining leaves at root (including star i=1). The polynomial identity (t-i)(i-3)-2(i-1)=(t-9)(i-3)-(i-5)^2 gives sign cutoff and unique n=9,10 maximizers. Uniform cubic limit yields 2/27 at i/t=2/3. Inspected all proof and checker.py at pinned Git tree; an independently written rational rooted-tree enumeration reproduced sharp values through n=11 (n=9 0; n=10 numerator 6; n=11 numerator 15). Finite tests corroborate but are not needed for the all-order proof.
